svg.title: 1:1 hedge ratio vs OLS beta hedge ratio comparison
svg.desc: Shows why fixed 1:1 allocation fails when volatilities differ, and how OLS beta corrects it
svg.text: A and B move cancel each other

g.text: β from OLS regression in Formation

svg.text: Shares: Long A = leg_capital / P_A Short B = beta × leg_capital / P_B
